page.overview:
Who is Kanae Kocho?

Several years prior to the present story, she was slain by Upper Rank Two, Doma.

Kanae was a girl of a slender build. She was taller than her sister, Shinobu, but still petite next to most Demon Slayers. Her lips were notably pink compared to her pale complexion. She had long, straight black hair that reached just below her waist, with two shorter portions coming over her shoulders; arched, ear-length bangs adorned both sides of her face. Her eyes were faintly violet-tinted, centered with darker purple and sparkly reflections, slanting towards the sides of her face.

Kanae wore the standard Demon Slayer Corps uniform, which is black in the manga and dark purple in the anime. Her uniform consisted of a button-up jacket with a stand-up collar and long sleeves. It featured gold buttons down the front, a shirt pocket on the left breast, and the kanji for |Metsu}} on the back. Beneath the jacket, she wore a white long-sleeved and collared undershirt. Her outfit was fastened at the waist with the standard white belt. She wore traditional tattsuke-hakama pants matching the tone of her uniform. Around her lower legs, Kanae wrapped a strip of black fabric, functioning similarly to kyahan, and wore dark purple tabi socks. On her feet, she wore zōri sandals with pale purple straps.

Over her uniform, Kanae wore a white butterfly-patterned haori (later worn by Shinobu) that transitioned to pale turquoise, then pink, toward the lower sleeves and the hem. The edges of the garment were trimmed in black and decorated with pale turquoise spots. She also sported a pair of green butterfly ornaments, which featured pink trim on the rims finished off with a decoration of white speckles. After her death, her adoptive younger sister, Kanao, began wearing one of the pins as a memento.
